title: Pete Worden knows more about NASA UFO knowledge

tellings.quote: well what I've heard is that uh certain people uh like uh uh Pete Weren um >> know a lot more about NASA's knowledge about the UFO phenomenon

plain: Certain people at NASA, among them a man named Pete Worden, are said to know far more than they let on about what the space agency knows of UFOs. Maaneli Derakhshani, a guest on an episode about NASA and the Moon, tells Michels this as something he has heard, not something he saw, saying such people 'know a lot more about NASA's knowledge about the UFO phenomenon'. If true, NASA would hold UFO knowledge that it has not made public.
